title: Impact on delirium of the use of DEXmedetomidine as first-line sedation in PEDIAtric intensive care: the PEDIADEX randomized controlled trial
official: Impact on delirium of the use of DEXmedetomidine as first-line sedation in PEDIAtric intensive care: the PEDIADEX randomized controlled trial
summary: Main objective: To assess if continuous intravenous infusion of dexmedetomidine is  effective to reduce the prevalence of delirium in critically ill children, needing mechanical ventilation for more than 12 hours.
conditions: Impact on delirium of the use of  DEXmedetomidine as first-line sedation in PEDIAtric intensive care:

interventions.name: Dexmedetomidine 100 micrograms/ml concentrate for solution for infusion
Midazolam Lek 1 mg/ml raztopina za injiciranje/infundiranje

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Children between 1 month to 17 years and 6 months
2. Participants covered by or entitled to French social security
3. Informed consent, dated and signed, from the participant's legal representative(s). (The emergency inclusion procedure will be used if the legal representative(s) cannot be contacted. When the legal representative(s) and the patient are available and/or able to consent, informed consent from the participant’s legal representative(s)
4. Ability for participant to comply with the requirements of the study
5. Receiving sedation by benzodiazepines for less than 6 hours at the time of inclusion
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients under guardianship, curatorship or legal protection
2. Palliative care on admission
3. Significant bradycardia (cf table)
4. Severe hepatic dysfunction (CHILD score C or worse) due to the hepatic metabolism of dexmedetomidine
5. Patient already enrolled in the study previously
6. Expected duration of invasive mechanical ventilation inferior to 12 hours
7. Hospitalized in a pediatric intensive care unit without computerized prescription software
8. Study interventions contraindications
9. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman (positive pregnancy test for women of childbearing age)
10. High-grade heart conduction disorder (Second or third-degree atrioventricular block)
11. Status epilepticus
12. Intracranial hypertension
13. Sedation for more than 6 hours by benzodiazepines at the time of inclusion
14. Need for paralytic medication (neuromuscular blocker) at admission to PICU
15. Following cardiac surgery
